 Charlotte faces a tough test against a red-hot Los Angeles team as both sides deal with key injuries ahead of Tuesday night's matchup. Mark Livingston | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Nov 12, 2026; Phoenix, Arizona, USA; Phoenix Suns forward Miles Bridges (left) defends against Charlotte Hornets guard Coby White in the second half at Mortgage Matchup Center. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect In this story:
 Charlotte Hornets The Charlotte Hornets continue their West Coast road trip Tuesday night with a matchup against the Los Angeles Lakers at Crypto.com Arena. Charlotte has dropped eight of its last nine games, while Los Angeles has won eight straight and enters the night with one of the best records in the Western Conference. Both teams will be without key players, including Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schröder for Charlotte and Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler for Los Angeles. Here are the projected starting lineups for tonight's matchup.
